clips.title: The story
paras: Nek'rosh's Head is the gruesome proof of the downfall of Chieftain Nek'rosh, leader of the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. Procured by Alliance adventurers, this trophy is delivered to Captain Stoutfist to confirm that the orcish threat menacing Menethil Harbor has been shattered.

The Dragonmaw clan poses a persistent danger across the marshlands, massing forces and siege weapons against the Alliance port of Menethil Harbor. After burning their catapults, the defense of the port hinges on slaying Chieftain Nek'rosh himself. Severing his head provides undeniable proof to Captain Stoutfist and the Ironforge authorities that the warlord's grip over the Wetlands is broken.
